metadata.description: User seeks help reviewing project files

message.content: Hello! How are you doing today?
Not very good. I want you to read my project files. Can you?

I'm really sorry you're feeling that way. I'm here to help however I can.

I can't directly open or read files on your computer, but if you paste the content of your project files here—or upload them if you're using a platform that supports file uploads—I can absolutely take a look and help you work through whatever's going wrong.

Feel free to share as much or as little as you're comfortable with.

I don’t have any tools that let me browse your local file system or open files you haven’t explicitly pasted/uploaded into the chat.  
If you can copy-and-paste the relevant code (or drag-and-drop a small file if your client supports uploads), I’ll read it immediately and we can figure out what’s going wrong.
What tools do you have now

Right now I don’t have any active tools plugged in—no file-browser, no web-search, no code-interpreter, etc.  
The only thing I can do is read whatever text you paste here (or any file you explicitly attach if your chat client offers an “upload” button).  
If you paste the code or error messages, I’ll help you debug them the old-fashioned way: by reading and reasoning through them with you.
